breakdown.reason: The generated specification says 'Use Strang splitting method with explicit forward Euler time integration,' which retains the conflicting 'explicit forward Euler' instruction. The ground truth resolves this by removing the forward Euler reference entirely, since the Strang splitting method uses exact (analytical) solutions for both the diffusion and reaction substeps, not forward Euler. The agent combined both conflicting instructions rather than removing the erroneous one.
